title: The AI Agent Rollout Pipeline
description: Five stages between choosing a tool and using it club-wide -- and what breaks if you skip each one.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: AI-Customized Curriculum and Rolling Out New Agents

educational.audience: Club leaders adopting an AI tool

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a stage of the rollout pipeline, the learner differentiates it from the stages before and after it and states what would go wrong if that stage were skipped.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Hover-to-preview and click-to-pin linear pipeline with a feedback loop from coaching back to design
pedagogical.assessment: Name a stage and ask what goes wrong if it is skipped.
